description: Label Convert. Convert printer commands from one language to another. POST source, from, and to. from is the source language (tsc, zpl, epl, …). to is the target (tsc, zpl, escpos, …). Credit cost: 5 credits per call.

dpi.description: Override DPI on the converted output.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

from.description: Source language. Allowed values: tsc, zpl, epl, cpcl, dpl, sbpl, ipl. Default: "tsc".

source.description: Raw printer commands to convert. Also send from and to.

to.description: Target language. Allowed values: tsc, zpl, epl, cpcl, dpl, sbpl, escpos, starprnt, ipl. Default: "tsc".

name: label_convert
title: Label Convert
